summary: Tested per-user creation blocks end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass covering admin JWT gating, Frasberg key rejection, 404 unknown email, 422 invalid kind, case-insensitive email, non-create policy preservation, enforcement 403 with 'Blocked by Frasberg engine rules: Action blocked by policy (create:<kind>)' on /api/generate/jobs, /api/video, /api/music, owner_label on /engines/creations, and unblock removing user from GET list. Frontend: /status admin user-blocks panel renders; aria-pressed toggles work; unknown email yields 'No user with that email' error toast; row toggles (user-block-{email}-kind-{kind}) and unblock button all produce correct success toasts. Final state restored (blockme@luchii.ai blocked for image/video/music, no global governance).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 2063: email is normalized with .strip().lower() for DB lookup but response echoes u['email'] (DB value). Good — avoids leaking the request's casing.
engine_systems.user_blocks() limits to 500 users which is sensible; sort key relies on string ordering of ISO timestamps.
UserBlockIn uses list[Literal[...]] — Pydantic correctly returns 422 for invalid kinds.
seed_data_creation: Ensured blockme@luchii.ai user exists via /api/auth/register (idempotent). State restored at end of run — blockme blocked for image/video/music, global governance empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_user_blocks_iter63.py uses direct motor DB access for seeding non-create policy actions because /api/engines/policy requires admin owner (regular user token cannot set own policy). The blocked endpoints image/video/music must stay blocked for blockme@luchii.ai across runs — test_zz_restore_blocked_state ensures this.
